headline: Executive order directs federal action to expand access to quality care and support people who provide care.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to take steps to make high-quality care easier to get. It also aims to support caregivers. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, programs, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People who need care and their families
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to make it easier for them to get high-quality care.
The order aims to provide them with more support.
They are expected to carry out the steps the order directs.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 18, 2023; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
